A loyal MAGA supporter learns the harsh reality of immigration enforcement firsthand.

'Terrified' MAGA couple turns on Trump after brutal encounter
Evidence: border security rhetoric, family detention ordeal, political disillusionment
#Aletheia #USPol

Supporters assumed immigration crackdowns would strictly target violent criminals, leaving legal residents and families untouched by enforcement overreach.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +1.00) — Good Preference

Federal enforcement swept up a woman with a pending green card, subjecting her to harsh detention conditions and exposing the sweeping collateral damage of policy.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.93, -0.93) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A policy marketed to protect citizens through targeted enforcement instead inflicts indiscriminate fear on mixed-status families.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, Uncertainty z: 2)

- Brent Jindra: FAIL (-0.70, -0.75) — Overlooked systemic policy harms until personally impacted.
- ICE Enforcement: FAIL (-0.80, -0.85) — Indiscriminate detention of pending-status residents.
A devoted Trump voter faced a 16-day detention ordeal when his Russian wife was arrested by immigration agents upon returning to California.

The Bright Side:
Personal encounters with systemic overreach sometimes bridge partisan divides and foster empathy for vulnerable immigrant communities.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (deterring dangerous criminals) with WHO (detaining a legal applicant). The systemic net swallows everyone indiscriminately.

Social Physics Analysis:
By relying on broad pretexts rather than transparent, precise criteria, the system protects political narratives while inflicting random human suffering.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic coercion replaces justice.

The Unavoidable Truth: Sweeping immigration policies inevitably trap legal applicants and families.

The Unavoidable Lie: Enforcement mechanisms only target dangerous criminals.

Alethekanon:
Rhetoric promised targeted security, but administrative machinery operates without human distinction.

Awwthekanon:
